intro: The Lattice bed gives you deep sleep and deeper storage. With its clean panels and colour-block tone, it helps you stay organised — while turning your bed into the boldest thing in the room.

features.title: Durability meets quiet elegance
features.text: Built from premium engineered wood, our bed combines everyday resilience with subtle style — crafted for comfort, designed for real life.

features.title: Effortless storage, hidden beneath
features.text: The hydraulic compartments open smoothly to reveal generous underbed storage — giving you space without clutter, and ease without compromise. Plus, all Upmods beds come with versatile storage options to suit your unique lifestyle.

features.title: Soft support that invites relaxation
features.text: Whether it’s bedtime reading or a weekend lie-in, the cushioned headboard offers all the comfort you need, right when you need it.

features.title: A finish that feels grounded and calm
features.text: The textured matte wood brings natural depth to your bedroom — clean, contemporary, and effortlessly calming.

features.title: Headboard storage with a thoughtful touch
features.text: Designed with your routines in mind, the built-in compartments and ledge keep your essentials close and your space beautifully ordered.

name: Upmods Lattice Queen Size Engineered Wood Bed With Hydraulic Storage
